messages:
Leah (PM): Heads-up - drafting a 'pin hedging' playbook to reduce customer friction during model migrations. Need concrete steps we can operationalize (comm timing, temporary shims, support SLAs, and when to offer credits). Starting thread to capture constraints.

Amit (Eng): Engineering constraints first: we need a defined fallback hierarchy in the catalog metadata (primary variant -> fallback variant id -> fallback weight). During cutover we can route X% to fallback automatically if metrics degrade. Also require a compat_tag and kernel_hint so infra can pick compatible fallbacks.

Sven (SRE): Ops needs: a 72-hour hedging window where we run dual-serving (old variant + new variant) with traffic split 90/10 -> 50/50 -> 10/90 -> cutover. Must document rollback triggers: sustained 2x error rate, p95 > 40% increase, or token-cost > 30% for 1h. Provide runbook snippet for auto-fallback.

Noelle (CS): From support: customers want clear comms. Proposed timeline: notice at T-21 days, migration window T-7 to T+7, and a single-page migration checklist. Offer optional assisted migration (checkbox in console) and list expected downtime (usually none). Also request a short template for customer success outreach.

Rui (Legal): Legal input: any credit or incentive must be opt-in and stored as consent record. If we promise migration credits, include expiration and scope (what ops are covered). Also require that customers acknowledge potential short-lived regressions during hedging and accept rollback policies.

catalog-bot: Created ticket #11011 "pin-hedging-playbook" https://redwood/tickets/11011

Amit (Eng): Benchmarks/acceptance criteria: require bench payload with samples >=500 for text models (200 for embed-only). Must include p50/p95/p99 and a cost estimate. Example: {"samples":1000,"p95_ms":210,"p99_ms":440,"avg_tokens":15,"cost_per_1M":0.65}. Also require an A/B eval on a standard prompt set with delta thresholds defined.

Leah (PM): Operational policy suggestion: default pin = 90d. For hedged migrations we can offer a shortened pin of 45d if customer opts into assisted migration and accepts credits. Fast-pass models can be 60d. We'll publish these options in the catalog entry and surface them in the console.

Sven (SRE): Monitoring addendum: during hedging enable detailed tracing to attribute latency regressions to kernels/quant variants and an alert for token-cost regression >20% sustained for 30m. Keep 30d telemetry for hedging windows; extend to 60d if assisted migration included.

Noelle (CS): Support asks: add an autogenerated migration-runbook in the customer portal (one-pager) with post-cutover validation steps (smoke queries, sample payload checks) and contacts for rollback. Also provide a comms email draft for AEs.

Rui (Legal): We'll draft minimal opt-in language. One more legal constraint: deprecation notices must have a minimum lead of 21 days unless customer explicitly waives it via consent flow.

Leah (PM): Prioritization: mark any model with >0.5% traffic or referenced in an enterprise contract as 'Hedging required' by default. Others can be opt-in. We'll create an automated classifier on ingest.

Amit (Eng): Implementation note: add a 'hedge_policy' JSON blob to catalog entries with fields: pre_cutover_days, hedging_steps (array of splits & durations), auto_fallback_thresholds, telemetry_profile, consent_required. That lets the runtime orchestrate hedges.

Sven (SRE): Runbook items: 1) start dual-serving in canary pool; 2) enable hedging alerts; 3) ramp traffic per policy; 4) validate A/B metrics at each step; 5) auto-switch or rollback based on thresholds; 6) notify AE/SE. I'll prepare a trimmed runbook template.

Noelle (CS): I'll draft the customer one-pager and AE email template. Request product include a 'migration complexity' score on the catalog so we can triage who gets an AE outreach.

Leah (PM): Actions: Amit -> schema for hedge_policy + fallback metadata; Sven -> runbook + alerts; Noelle -> customer comms + templates; Rui -> opt-in/legal copy. I'll update #11011 and schedule a 30m sync Thursday 10:30. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
